facts.fact: Starlink officially launched in Maseru on Monday 30 June 2025 through exclusive reseller T-Connect Lesotho, at M10 per access session with hotspots planned in all 10 districts.
Starlink operates in Lesotho under a 10-year licence (grant date not given; date is the article's publication date), with opposition over foreign ownership and a fast-tracking allegation.
